Based on the H.4.1 report (Table 7), Federal Reserve notes outstanding totaled **$2,827,302 million**, of which **$406,743 million** was held by F.R. Banks and not subject to collateralization.

This gives a proportion of:

**406,743 / 2,827,302 ≈ 14.4%**

So approximately **14.4%** of Federal Reserve notes outstanding were not subject to collateralization as of Wednesday, July 29, 2026.
